Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| Restaurant | Location | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|----------|------------------------|
| **Baan Thai** | 1110 W. Belmont Ave (West Loop) | Offers a dedicated vegetarian menu featuring curries, pad thai, and fresh salads. |
| **Siam Square** | 2001 N. Clark St (Near West Side) | Has a “Vegetarian” section on its menu; try the green curry or tofu pad see. |
| **Thai Orchid** | 1400 W. 18th St (West Town) | Provides a separate vegetarian menu with options like vegetable spring rolls and tofu satay. |
| **Mango Tree** | 400 S. Wabash Ave (Loop) | Known for its “Vegetarian” menu items such as vegetable khao soi and tofu pad kee mao. |
| **Siam House** | 1200 W. 19th St (West Town) | Offers a vegetarian menu with dishes like vegetable pad see ew and tofu green curry. |

All of these places have good reviews for their vegetarian offerings and are conveniently located in different parts of the city. If you’d like more detailed information—such as hours, phone numbers, or specific dish recommendations—just let me know!
